bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; allowing modified school year start dates.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SCHOOL START DATE FOR THE 2026-2027 AND 2027-2028 SCHOOL YEARS ONLY.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 120A.40, paragraph (a), or other law to the contrary, for the 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 school years only, a school board may vote to begin the school year on September 1 or later. Nothing in this section limits a district's authority to begin the school year on any day before Labor Day under section 120A.40, paragraph (b).

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

A bill for an act relating to education; allowing a school year to start before Labor Day for two school years; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+SCHOOL START DATE FOR THE 2025-2026 AND 2026-2027 SCHOOL YEARS ONLY. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 120A.40, or other law to the contrary, for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 school years only, a school board may vote to begin the school year before Labor Day. +]

[+(b) A district that begins the school year before Labor Day under this section must report its start date to the commissioner of education in the form and manner determined by the commissioner. By January 5, 2027, the commissioner must submit a report to the legislative committees with jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education listing the school districts that began the 2025-2026 or 2026-2027 school year after Labor Day. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; allowing a school year to start before Labor Day for two school years; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SCHOOL START DATE FOR THE 2025-2026 AND 2026-2027 SCHOOL YEARS ONLY.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 120A.40, or other law to the contrary, for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 school years only, a school board may vote to begin the school year before Labor Day.

(b) A district that begins the school year before Labor Day under this section must report its start date to the commissioner of education in the form and manner determined by the commissioner. By January 5, 2027, the commissioner must submit a report to the legislative committees with jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education listing the school districts that began the 2025-2026 or 2026-2027 school year after Labor Day.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: SCHOOL START DATE FOR THE 2025-2026 AND 2026-2027 SCHOOL YEARS ONLY.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 120A.40, or other law to the contrary, for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 school years only, a school board may vote to begin the school year before Labor Day.

(b) A district that begins the school year before Labor Day under this section must report its start date to the commissioner of education in the form and manner determined by the commissioner. By January 5, 2027, the commissioner must submit a report to the legislative committees with jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education listing the school districts that began the 2025-2026 or 2026-2027 school year after Labor Day.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
